metric_boundaries: Directive presence and exact distinct strings are valid byte metadata.
Raw repeated PSM material-like strings cannot count visible objects, triangles, physical instances, or PC materials.
A standalone surface directive can belong to collision metadata; a shader-bearing string is stronger rendering metadata but is still not a decoded draw.
Identical filenames alone do not establish course pairing; see course-pairs.json.

course_material_metadata.comparison_metric: Directive presence in decoded landscape PSM printable runs versus parsed PC course TXT material names; raw occurrences and material record counts are not compatible physical metrics.
